**The document's text doesn't give either RACE dev accuracy, for 0 layers or for all 12.** These numbers would be in Figure 2 (left), which plots MultiNLI and RACE performance against the number of layers transferred (p. 7). This version includes that figure only as an image, so its values can't be read here. You'd need to check the plot in the original PDF.

The text near the figure says only:

- Transferring embeddings improves performance, and each transformer layer adds further benefit, "up to 9% for full transfer on MultiNLI" (p. 7). That 9% figure is for MultiNLI, not RACE.
- The authors conclude that "each layer in the pre-trained model contains useful functionality for solving target tasks" (p. 7).

The only RACE accuracy for the full model is in Table 3: 59.0 overall (62.9 on RACE-m, 57.4 on RACE-h). That table is in Section 4.2, which starts on p. 5; the document doesn't mark the exact page of the table. The document doesn't say whether these are dev or test scores, and they shouldn't be taken as the Figure 2 values.
